title: 新手引导与机制说明不足
description: 游戏缺乏有效的教程和机制说明，导致玩家难以理解核心操作和系统，学习曲线陡峭，上手困难。
evidence: got overwhelmed by the game's crapload of unique mechanics at the start of my first character
game tutorial just teaching you the simplest mechanics of the game
There is definitely a learning curve to this game.

evidence_items.quote: How does Character creation work? What do the choices *mean* in the context of the game? What does "skilled" mean?
evidence_items.description: 角色创建和技能系统缺乏说明，技能效果和提升方式不明确
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色创建是怎么运作的？在游戏语境下，这些选择*意味着*什么？“熟练”又是什么意思？

evidence_items.quote: The worst tutorial drifts the beginner ship into the nearest planet, even noclipping into it to the point where you are constantly crashing INSIDE a planet.
evidence_items.description: 教程中飞船撞入行星
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最糟糕的新手教程会把新手飞船漂移到最近的行星上，甚至穿模进入其中，以至于你不断地在一颗行星内部坠毁。

evidence_items.quote: Live on ship forget you need to breathe die live again
evidence_items.description: 氧气机制不明确，导致角色意外死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 住在船上忘了你需要呼吸死了再活一次

evidence_items.quote: the uninstall takes ages. Upon further research, you require a skill (which you can only guess at if not using the wiki) to improve the time it takes
evidence_items.description: 拆卸耗时过长，需要技能但只能靠维基猜测
evidence_items.quote_zh: 卸载要花很久。进一步研究后发现，你需要一个技能（如果不用wiki就只能靠猜）来缩短所需时间

evidence_items.quote: Die Lernkurve ist steil. Der Einstieg könnte deutlich besser sein
evidence_items.description: 学习曲线陡峭，入门体验差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 学习曲线很陡峭。入门引导本可以明显做得更好

evidence_items.quote: I say "aim" but there's no clear objective at all. Should I be lowering their Self Worth? Raising their Intimacy? Keeping their Altruism stable? I've no idea!
evidence_items.description: 与NPC的对话系统缺乏明确目标，不清楚该提升或降低哪些社交属性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我说“目标”，但根本没有任何明确的目标。我该降低他们的自我价值吗？提高他们的亲密感？保持他们的利他主义稳定？我完全不知道！

evidence_items.quote: something that simple as talking to NPC, I have no idea what's going on there, and the game doesn't explain it either.
evidence_items.description: 与NPC对话机制没有解释
evidence_items.quote_zh: 像和NPC说话这样简单的事情，我完全不知道那里发生了什么，游戏也没有解释。

evidence_items.quote: За одно нажатие ваши статы будут прыгать ТРИЖДЫ
evidence_items.description: 社交互动系统效果不明确，属性变化混乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 按一次你的属性就会跳三次

evidence_items.quote: if you don't pick EVA and Mechanical you're going to have a bad time engaging the main early game loop of salvaging
evidence_items.description: 不选EVA和机械技能就无法顺利进入早期打捞循环
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你不选EVA和机械技能，你在参与打捞这个主要的早期游戏循环时会很难受

evidence_items.quote: It's quite a slog to go from the initial salvage gameplay loop to other ones because the torch drive and tanks needs a beast of a ship making going to hubs for bounty hunting, mining impactical.
evidence_items.description: 从打捞循环过渡到其他玩法需要巨大飞船，导致其他玩法不切实际
evidence_items.quote_zh: 从最初的打捞游戏循环过渡到其他循环相当费劲，因为热核驱动和燃料罐需要一艘庞然大物般的飞船，使得前往枢纽进行赏金狩猎、采矿变得不切实际。

evidence_items.quote: It could use more in-game explanation of the mechanics. Right now, you will be searching for answers on forums or watching tutorial videos.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内缺乏机制说明，玩家需要去论坛或看教程视频学习。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它可以在游戏内对机制做更多解释。现在，你得去论坛上找答案或者看教程视频。

evidence_items.quote: Dieing because I cant figure out how to do something as simple as fill my O2 bottle for my suite
evidence_items.description: 不知道如何给氧气瓶充氧
evidence_items.quote_zh: 因为搞不懂怎么给我宇航服上的O2瓶充气这种简单的事而死掉

evidence_items.quote: couldn't figure out how to administer medicine
evidence_items.description: 无法弄清楚如何给药
evidence_items.quote_zh: 搞不懂怎么给药

evidence_items.quote: Сложность жопоразрывающая. Понять что игра от тебя хочет очень сложно.
evidence_items.description: 难度极高，难以理解游戏要求
evidence_items.quote_zh: 难度简直要命。很难理解游戏到底想让你做什么。

evidence_items.quote: Why ship smoking? WHY SHIP SMOKING?! TELL ME HOW DO ANYTHING!!
evidence_items.description: 飞船冒烟，玩家不知道原因和如何处理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为什么飞船在冒烟？为什么飞船在冒烟？！告诉我怎么才能做任何事！！

evidence_items.quote: Apart from the very basics in the tutorial, you're thrown into the deep end with no sense of direction besides ''rip apart ship, drag parts back to sell, and repeat''.
evidence_items.description: 教程后缺乏方向指引，玩家被直接丢入游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了教程里最基础的内容之外，你直接被扔进深水区，除了“拆解飞船、把零件拖回来卖掉、然后重复”之外，没有任何方向感。

evidence_items.quote: Way too hard to figure out even with the Tutorials then at the start I got stuck in the ship with no power trying to figure out how to get out
evidence_items.description: 即使有教程也难以理解游戏机制，开局在无动力的飞船里卡住不知如何出去
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就算有教程也太难搞懂了，然后一开始我就被困在没电的飞船里，拼命想弄清楚怎么出去

evidence_items.quote: hard to play
evidence_items.description: 游戏很难上手。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很难上手

evidence_items.quote: the wants/needs are a pain to manage as a new player
evidence_items.description: 新玩家难以管理需求系统
evidence_items.quote_zh: 作为新玩家，管理需求/欲望很痛苦

evidence_items.quote: a heavy learning curve with what to do and how things work
evidence_items.description: 学习曲线陡峭，不清楚该做什么以及机制如何运作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 该做什么以及事物如何运作的学习曲线很陡峭

evidence_items.quote: Every mechanic is obnoxiously obtuse
evidence_items.description: 每个机制都令人费解地晦涩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每个机制都令人恼火地晦涩难懂

evidence_items.quote: obscure and complex systems
evidence_items.description: 游戏系统复杂晦涩，容易让玩家不知所措
evidence_items.quote_zh: 晦涩而复杂的系统

evidence_items.quote: Have very high learning curve to learn how to play
evidence_items.description: 学习如何游玩的门槛很高
evidence_items.quote_zh: 要学会怎么玩有非常高的学习曲线

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial is a mission that leads you to die or get bugged not realizing its bugged cause there is no insight in how anything about health is supposed to work
evidence_items.description: 教程任务中玩家会死亡或卡bug，且游戏没有说明生命值系统如何运作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程是一个任务，它会让你死掉或遇到bug，而你还没意识到它出bug了，因为关于健康到底该怎么运作，完全没有给出任何说明

evidence_items.quote: crew management is difficult and unexplained
evidence_items.description: 船员管理困难且缺乏解释，难以进行最优规划
evidence_items.quote_zh: 船员管理既困难又没有说明

evidence_items.quote: a fire randomly starts in my ship, i just started the game so i have no idea what the cause of my fires are
evidence_items.description: 游戏刚开始时飞船随机起火，玩家不知道起火原因
evidence_items.quote_zh: 说实话我确实喜欢这个游戏，我打算给个好评，因为这是我非常喜欢的那种游戏类型，我基本上从来不写评测哈哈，但我买游戏之前确实读了评测，还心想不可能那么糟吧。结果你瞧，我的飞船里随机起火了，我才刚开始玩，所以完全不知道起火的原因是什么，我还开着新手船，而且我没有大量材料来修理飞船的每个角落，火烧穿了我的飞船，我修不了，我死了，我读档，我把火扑灭，我在太空里玩了大约 20 分钟，又起火了，我把它扑灭，但我根本不知道你可以排空空气，所以我被烟熏死了，我又读档，我到了一个空间站，我的飞船着火了，我的墙壁和部件烧了起来，我又读档因为我死了哈哈，这是个没完没了的循环，所以我要么重新开始，要么读一个早得 waaaaaaaaaaaaay 多的存档，因为我没法这样玩下去，每 20-40 分钟就死一次，我有点把自己软锁在这个处境里了，所以是我自己的错，它绝对有潜力，虽然确实有点烦人，而且我雇了一个船员，还有个死亡费用，基本上就是人寿保险，要 5 万，而我只有 2 万，还有利息，所以我每个“班次”都要付给这个女人 9 千，因为我付不起哈哈，吃一堑长一智

evidence_items.quote: way too hard to learn
evidence_items.description: 游戏太难上手学习
evidence_items.quote_zh: 学习起来太难了

evidence_items.quote: The new tutorial is a little janky
evidence_items.description: 新教程有些粗糙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 新的教程有点粗糙

evidence_items.quote: learning how to play the game isn't fun at all, it's tedious and dull
evidence_items.description: 学习如何游玩过程枯燥乏味
evidence_items.quote_zh: 学习如何玩这个游戏一点都不好玩，既乏味又无聊

evidence_items.quote: docking is an under-explained and overcomplicated process, I smashed my ship into the side of the station instantly killing me and ending my run
evidence_items.description: 对接过程缺乏说明且过于复杂，导致撞毁空间站并结束游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对接是一个解释不足且过于复杂的过程，我把我的飞船撞到了空间站侧面，当场死亡并结束了我的这一局

evidence_items.quote: game tutorial just teaching you the simplest mechanics of the game
evidence_items.description: 教程只教最简单的机制，未解释其他机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏教程只教你游戏里最简单的机制

evidence_items.quote: mechanics of the game is overcomplicated and there is no manuel to help u for some of them
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制过于复杂且没有手册帮助玩家理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的机制过于复杂，而且对于其中一些机制没有手册来帮你

evidence_items.quote: mechanics that were not explained well, if at all
evidence_items.description: 机制缺乏解释，现已基本修复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有得到很好解释、甚至根本没有解释的机制

evidence_items.quote: got overwhelmed by the game's crapload of unique mechanics at the start of my first character
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制繁多，新玩家一开始会不知所措
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在我第一个角色开局时，被游戏里一大堆独特的机制搞得不知所措

evidence_items.quote: the game is painfully difficult to learn, you'll be reliant on youtube tutorials just to get a grasp
evidence_items.description: 游戏学习曲线陡峭，需要依赖教程
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏学起来痛苦地困难，你只能依赖YouTube教程才能勉强上手

evidence_items.quote: it's overwhelmingly complex
evidence_items.description: 游戏过于复杂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它复杂得让人受不了

evidence_items.quote: some mechanics can be fairly obtuse
evidence_items.description: 部分机制相当晦涩难懂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些机制可能相当晦涩难懂

evidence_items.quote: The Torch Drive system is also a little hard to understand, even with the in-game manuals
evidence_items.description: 火炬驱动系统即使有游戏内手册也难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 火炬驱动系统也有点难以理解，即使有游戏内手册也一样

evidence_items.quote: some of the systems like air, heating, flying are poorly explained
evidence_items.description: 空气、加热、飞行等系统解释不清
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些系统，比如空气、供暖、飞行，解释得很差

evidence_items.quote: I spent an hour trying to figure out how to pick up my gear and walk to my ship;
evidence_items.description: 花一小时也没搞懂如何拾取装备并走向飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我花了一个小时试图弄清楚如何捡起我的装备并走到我的飞船那里；

evidence_items.quote: the game does a poor job of explaining basic mechanics of the game to the player
evidence_items.description: 游戏未能向玩家解释基本机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏在向玩家解释基本机制方面做得很差

evidence_items.quote: the only way you could even hope to understand half the mechanics and builds of the game is if you A) have a phd in physics and astrophysics etc. or if you scour the wiki for 5 hours
evidence_items.description: 机制过于复杂难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你甚至能指望理解这游戏一半的机制和建造系统的唯一方法，就是A）拥有物理学和天体物理学等领域的博士学位，或者你花5个小时翻遍wiki

evidence_items.quote: im looking at it but i havent a clue what im to do
evidence_items.description: 玩家不知道该做什么，缺乏引导
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我看着它，但我完全不知道我该做什么

evidence_items.quote: I have no idea how to navigate my ship properly.
evidence_items.description: 不知道如何正确驾驶飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我完全不知道如何正确地驾驶我的飞船。

evidence_items.quote: I feel immediately overwhelmed with options in the character creation area.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建选项过多，令人不知所措
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我在角色创建区域立刻就被各种选项淹没了。

evidence_items.quote: I wish there was better explanation of how to pick up some of the missing skills in game
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时缺少如何获取缺失技能的说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我希望游戏里能更好地解释如何获得一些缺失的技能

evidence_items.quote: my character had a sad face, 10 seconds later they're exhausted from being up for 72 hours (I don't think I've even been playing that long, the sleep bar was empty?) then they pass out and die from asphyxiation. I'm assuming there was an invisible leak in the ship - run ended.
evidence_items.description: 角色状态变化缺乏明确反馈，如突然疲惫、昏倒并窒息死亡，玩家无法理解原因
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色露出了悲伤的表情，10秒后他们就因为连续72小时没睡而精疲力竭（我觉得我根本没玩那么久，睡眠条是空的？）然后他们昏倒并因窒息而死。我猜飞船上有看不见的泄漏——这局结束了。

evidence_items.quote: Most skills are super vague as to what they do
evidence_items.description: 大多数技能描述非常模糊，不清楚具体作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数技能的作用都非常模糊

evidence_items.quote: the poor tutorial that breaks a lot!
evidence_items.description: 教程经常出问题，无法正确展示游戏内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那个经常出问题的糟糕教程！

evidence_items.quote: focusing on thoroughly unfun and needlessly complicated simulation aspects
evidence_items.description: 游戏模拟机制过于复杂且乏味，整体显得浅薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 专注于完全不有趣且不必要地复杂的模拟方面

evidence_items.quote: I can't get the Tutorial to actually LEAD me through the controls and Game Play
evidence_items.description: 教程未能引导玩家了解控制和玩法
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我无法让教程真正引导我了解操作和游戏玩法

evidence_items.quote: this game is way way to complicated to understand and remember
evidence_items.description: 游戏过于复杂，难以理解和记忆
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏实在太复杂了，根本没法理解和记住

evidence_items.quote: There's a million and one things to keep track of, and you're thrown off the deep end almost immediately
evidence_items.description: 大量系统需要跟踪，几乎立刻被扔进深水区
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有千千万万件事需要跟踪，而你几乎立刻就被扔进了深水区

evidence_items.quote: I keep dying for reasons I don't understand
evidence_items.description: 玩家因不明原因死亡，缺乏解释。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我一直因为我不明白的原因而死

evidence_items.quote: The correct way to play isn't taught to you, and you will doom several characters before understanding what happened
evidence_items.description: 游戏未教授正确玩法，导致玩家多次失败。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 正确的玩法没人教你，你会在搞明白发生了什么之前就毁掉好几个角色

evidence_items.quote: Some of the mechanics and missions you rely on are noob-traps or actual outright traps
evidence_items.description: 部分机制和任务成为新手陷阱或实际陷阱。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你依赖的一些机制和任务要么是新手陷阱，要么就是彻头彻尾的陷阱

evidence_items.quote: The game is a overly complicated mess
evidence_items.description: 游戏过于复杂，难以理解。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏是一团过于复杂的乱麻

evidence_items.quote: you won't be able to access any of the gameplay unless you can first figure out how to leave your ship
evidence_items.description: 缺乏清晰说明，难以离开飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除非你先弄清楚怎么离开你的飞船，否则你根本无法接触到任何游戏内容

evidence_items.quote: There's combat in the game, but you're not told what's involved, there's no tutorial on those mechanics at all, and the UI is as opaque for those tasks as it is for every other, so good luck.
evidence_items.description: 战斗机制没有教程或解释，UI 不透明。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且这些任务的UI和其他所有任务一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运吧。

evidence_items.quote: Got hit with a $15,000 fine for illegal salvage, ending my game before it really started because I was already in debt from my ship and couldn't pay for fuel or fees. I know you can buy a permit to salvage legally but I've yet to find [i]where or how[/i].
evidence_items.description: 玩家不知道如何或在哪里购买合法打捞许可证，导致被罚款。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我买船已经负债，付不起燃料费或各种费用。我知道可以买许可证来合法打捞，但我至今没找到[i]在哪里、怎么买[/i]。

evidence_items.quote: It is hard, with minimal tutorials.
evidence_items.description: 教程极少，游戏难度高
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它很难，教程极少。

evidence_items.quote: this game isn't intuitive enough to not have an in-depth tutorial that walks you through the basics. If you have enough time to read a bunch of guides you might have some fun
evidence_items.description: 游戏不够直观，缺乏深入的新手教程，需要阅读大量指南才能上手
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏不够直观，却没有一个带你了解基础操作的深入教程。如果你有足够的时间读一大堆指南，也许能玩得有点乐趣

evidence_items.quote: the difference how the tutorial is structured and how the player is eased into the game's mechanics is totally night and day vs. Ostranauts
evidence_items.description: 教程结构差，没有逐步引导玩家理解机制，需要数小时反复重试才能入门
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程的结构方式以及玩家被引导进入游戏机制的方式，与《Ostranauts》相比简直是天壤之别

evidence_items.quote: Personally, I feel like it is overly complex without much payoff
evidence_items.description: 生存系统过于复杂且回报不足
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就个人而言，我觉得它过于复杂，却没有多少回报

evidence_items.quote: the game's tutorial somehow explains less than bare minimum, just a little bit above nothing and just leads to frustration
evidence_items.description: 教程解释不足，需要外部资源学习
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的教程不知怎么解释得比最低限度还少，只比什么都没有强一点点，只会导致挫败感

evidence_items.quote: The tutorial also actively puts you in a position to get a hefty fine for illegally salvaging and you'll have no idea
evidence_items.description: 教程让玩家在不知情的情况下因非法打捞而被重罚
evidence_items.quote_zh: 教程还会主动把你置于因非法打捞而被重罚的境地，而你根本不会知道

evidence_items.quote: Doesn't do a great job of explaining some aspects of gameplay
evidence_items.description: 游戏对部分玩法机制解释不清

evidence_items.quote: Extremely complicated. Nothing is explained. I've died because I didn't understand how docking worked. I've died because I told my character to pry open a crate and he went to get a crowbar from a section of ship that had no atmosphere without a helmet. I've died because I didn't understand the fuel system, ran out of fuel, and just shot across the universe at a relative velocity of 300 meters per second forever without the ability to brake or change directions.
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制完全没有解释，导致玩家因不理解而死亡。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 极其复杂。什么都没解释。我死过，因为我不懂对接是怎么运作的。我死过，因为我让我的角色撬开一个箱子，他没戴头盔就跑去一个没有大气的飞船区域拿撬棍。我死过，因为我不懂燃料系统，燃料耗尽，然后以每秒300米的相对速度永远地飞过宇宙，无法刹车或改变方向。

evidence_items.quote: você tem tanta coisa pra controlar ao mesmo tempo, você tem que cuidar da tua nave, enquanto controla ela, enquanto controla seu personagem que tem emoções e que tem necessidades que tem amigos e familia e que tem pessoas que trabalham na nave com ele que também tem suas necessidades e emoções e que além disso tem relacionamentos com você
evidence_items.description: 游戏机制过于复杂，需要同时管理大量系统，对新手不友好。
evidence_items.quote_zh:
你同时有太多东西要控制，你得照看你的飞船，一边操控它，一边操控你的角色，而角色有情绪、有需求、有朋友和家人，还有和他一起在飞船上工作的人，那些人也有自己的需求和情绪，除此之外他们还和你有人际关系，如果你不小心，可能就会把整摊子事搞砸，而且除此之外，游戏还让你开局就带着一个满是减益的角色，你得用角色仅剩的没几年时间专门去消除这些减益，没错，你的角色有年龄，越老越糟，所以你要么在18岁大好年华开局，但一团糟，要么至少30岁开局才能有0减益。

这游戏基本上就是往蛋上踹一脚，只有你想受苦才买，或者等它发布，说不定到那时候游戏会加个教程，去掉一些没用的机制，比如那300条社交条，并简化成更容易消化的东西。
